parts.label: (a)
parts.answer: Stretch by scale factor 2 parallel to the $y$-axis, then translate by $\begin{pmatrix}3\\-4\end{pmatrix}$; or translate by $\begin{pmatrix}3\\-2\end{pmatrix}$ then stretch by factor 2 parallel to the $y$-axis.
parts.official_mark_scheme_text: Method 1: stretch, scale factor 2, parallel to/in/on the $y$-axis or with the $x$-axis invariant — B2,1,0; B2 for all three elements and B1 for two. Translation $\begin{pmatrix}3\\-4\end{pmatrix}$, or +3 in the $x$-direction and -4 in the $y$-direction — B2,1,0; B2 for all three elements and B1 for two; do not condone right/down in place of directions. The vector may be split into $\begin{pmatrix}3\\0\end{pmatrix}$ and $\begin{pmatrix}0\\-4\end{pmatrix}$. Correct order with no extra transformations — B1. Right/down may be condoned for this order mark if intention is clear. Combined translations, or specifically $\begin{pmatrix}0\\-4\end{pmatrix}$, must follow the stretch. Method 2: translation $\begin{pmatrix}3\\-2\end{pmatrix}$, or +3 in $x$ and -2 in $y$ — B2,1,0, with the same direction condition; it may be split into $\begin{pmatrix}3\\0\end{pmatrix}$ and $\begin{pmatrix}0\\-2\end{pmatrix}$. Stretch factor 2 parallel to/in/on the $y$-axis or $x$-axis invariant — B2,1,0. Correct order, no extras — B1; right/down may be condoned for this mark, and combined translations or $\begin{pmatrix}0\\-2\end{pmatrix}$ must precede the stretch. Total 5.
